scenes.text: You are walking in the park and you see a wallet on the ground. You pick it up. There is a lot of money inside, and an ID card. What do you do?

choices.text: Take it to the police station.

scenes.text: You decide to keep the money. You go to a store and buy a lot of video games. But you feel guilty all day. Was it worth it? The end.
You walk to the police station and give them the wallet. The police officer thanks you. Two days later, the owner calls you and gives you a reward! You did the right thing. The end.
